episodes.synopsis: Sitara, a young slave girl, is sold to a family of scholars, where she begins her journey of knowledge.
episodes.title: All That Is in the Heavens and All That Is in the Earth

episodes.synopsis: As nomads sack the city of Tun, Fatima and Sitara hide in the basement and wait for the others to return.
episodes.title: The Roses That Bloom in Safar

episodes.synopsis: Sitara teams up with an unexpected ally in hopes of reclaiming Fatima's book that was stolen by the Mongols.
episodes.title: An Undying Flame

episodes.synopsis: Sitara begins tutoring Sorghaghtani in Euclid's Elements, and learns more about Prince Tolui, the Otchigin.
episodes.title: Otchigin

episodes.synopsis: Sitara agrees to serve as Sorghaghtani's spy, but her plans to infiltrate Chagatai's court quickly go awry.
episodes.title: A Snake Shows Its Colors, Man Hides His Colors

episodes.synopsis: Töregene tells the tale of her life among the Merkits, a confederation of tribes renowned for their archery.
episodes.title: The Mergen People

episodes.synopsis: As the Mongol Empire prepares to wage war to the east, Sitara begins to plant the seeds of political intrigue.
episodes.title: Brothers

episodes.synopsis: After a misunderstanding, Sitara finds herself before the sickly Boraqchin, chief empress of the Mongols.
episodes.title: Great Khatun Boraqchin

episodes.synopsis: Ögedei and Tolui launch their offensive to take the Jin capital Kaifeng, but tragedy strikes soon after.
episodes.title: Tengri

episodes.synopsis: Tolui meets a shocking fate, and Sitara receives an unexpected item that shakes her to the core of her being.
episodes.title: Wisdom

episodes.synopsis: Six years in the past, Boraqchin encounters a stone with mysterious properties that would change her life.
episodes.title: An Ungraceful Stone
